The error came from the word "input" appearing in comments. The tool rejects that word as a forbidden I/O construct, even inside a comment. I reworded those comments and left the circuit unchanged.

```python
PARAMS = {
    "gmid1": (14.0, 10.0, 18.0),     # diff pair gm/Id
    "L1":    (1.0, 0.5, 2.0),        # diff pair L (flicker noise / gain)
    "gmid3": (13.0, 9.0, 15.0),      # PMOS mirror + M7 gm/Id (same -> no systematic offset)
    "L3":    (0.5, 0.35, 1.0),
    "gmidb": (13.0, 9.0, 16.0),      # NMOS bias/tail/sink gm/Id
    "Lb":    (1.0, 0.5, 2.0),
    "Cc":    (0.8e-12, 0.4e-12, 1.5e-12),
    "fu":    (32e6, 26e6, 45e6),     # design GBW target
    "kp2":   (3.5, 2.5, 5.0),        # gm7 = kp2*gm1*CL/Cc
    "rzk":   (0.7, 0.4, 1.2),        # Rz = rzk*(1+CL/Cc)/gm7
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    CL = spec.get("cl", 2e-12); iref = spec.get("iref", 10e-6); VDD = 1.8
    Cc = p["Cc"]
    gm1 = 2 * PI * p["fu"] * Cc
    I1 = gm1 / p["gmid1"]
    gm7 = p["kp2"] * gm1 * CL / Cc
    I7 = gm7 / p["gmid3"]

    mb = lut.size("n", p["gmidb"], p["Lb"], iref, vds=0.65)
    m5 = lut.size("n", p["gmidb"], p["Lb"], 2 * I1, vds=0.25)
    m8 = lut.size("n", p["gmidb"], p["Lb"], I7, vds=0.9)
    m1 = lut.size("n", p["gmid1"], p["L1"], I1, vds=0.55)
    m3 = lut.size("p", p["gmid3"], p["L3"], I1, vds=1.0)
    m7 = lut.size("p", p["gmid3"], p["L3"], I7, vds=0.9)

    Rz = p["rzk"] * (1 + CL / Cc) / m7.gm

    n = Netlist("vinp vinn vout vdd vss ibias")
    n.dev("MB", "ibias", "ibias", "vss", "vss", mb)
    n.dev("M5", "tail", "ibias", "vss", "vss", m5)
    # M1 (vinn) on diode side, M2 (vinp) on output side -> non-inverting at vinp
    n.dev("M1", "n1", "vinn", "tail", "vss", m1)
    n.dev("M2", "x", "vinp", "tail", "vss", m1)
    n.dev("M3", "n1", "n1", "vdd", "vdd", m3)
    n.dev("M4", "x", "n1", "vdd", "vdd", m3)
    n.dev("M7", "vout", "x", "vdd", "vdd", m7)
    n.dev("M8", "vout", "ibias", "vss", "vss", m8)
    n.R("RZ", "x", "nc", Rz)
    n.C("CC", "nc", "vout", Cc)

    A1 = m1.gm / (m1.gds + m3.gds)
    A2 = m7.gm / (m7.gds + m8.gds)
    gain_db = db(A1 * A2)
    ugbw = m1.gm / (2 * PI * Cc)
    Cx = m7.cgg + m3.cdd + m1.cdd
    fp2 = m7.gm * Cc / (2 * PI * (Cx * (CL + Cc) + CL * Cc))
    fz = 1.0 / (2 * PI * Cc * (Rz - 1.0 / m7.gm)) if Rz > 1.0 / m7.gm else 1e12
    fp3 = 1.0 / (2 * PI * Rz * Cx)
    fmir = m3.gm / (2 * PI * 2 * m3.cgg)
    pm = 90 - math.degrees(math.atan(ugbw / fp2)) + math.degrees(math.atan(ugbw / fz)) \
         - math.degrees(math.atan(ugbw / fp3)) - math.degrees(math.atan(ugbw / fmir)) / 2
    cmrr_db = db(2 * m1.gm / m5.gds * m3.gm / (m1.gds + m3.gds) * 0.5)
    psrr_db = gain_db - 3
    power = VDD * (iref + 2 * I1 + I7)
    slew = min(2 * I1 / Cc, I7 / (CL + Cc))
    swing = VDD - m7.vdsat - m8.vdsat - 0.05
    kT = 1.38e-23 * 300
    noise_th = math.sqrt(16 * kT / (3 * m1.gm) * (1 + m3.gm / m1.gm))
    noise_1k = noise_th * 6.0      # flicker-dominated estimate at 1 kHz
    settle = 4.6 / (2 * PI * ugbw * 0.7) + 0.5 / slew
    return n, {"gain_db": gain_db, "ugbw": ugbw, "pm": pm, "cmrr_db": cmrr_db,
               "psrr_db": psrr_db, "power": power, "slew": slew, "swing": swing,
               "noise_1k": noise_1k, "settle": settle, "polarity": 1}
```
